Commentary.Commentary: Now then, 328 is the target! The wicket is true but Pakistan will have to bat really well against an Australian attack which has fared well in the series so far. Will they avoid a whitewash? We will have to wait and watch.

The Pakistan bowling was not that great. Yes there was not a lot of assistance for them from the surface but the line and lengths were also not that great. Usman Khan was the only bright spot as he finished with a 4-fer. Had he got support, the story could have been a lot better for the hosts.

Another excellent batting performance from the Australian batters! Their top order came to the fore once again. After being inserted, Finch and Khawaja went about their things quite smoothly. Their partnership accounted for 134 which laid the foundation for a big score. The skipper departed after scoring a half ton but Marsh continued the good work. He along with Khawaja amassed another excellent partnership before Usman was dismissed on 98. Maxwell then came out all guns blazing and provided the much-needed impetus his team needed. His 33-ball 70 ensured Australia finish with something above 300.
A great delivery to end. Yorker length, Jason digs it towards the cover-point region for a double. 11 scored from the last over. AUSTRALIA END WITH 327!
Length delivery on leg, Behrendorff gives it a hard swing but the ball runs down the square leg region off the inner half for a double.
Full on leg, Richardson tries a heave but gets an inside age onto the fine leg region. Single added.
FOUR! Down to fine leg. Khan drifts this down the leg side. Richardson just wrists it towards the fine leg region for a boundary. Richardson gets off the mark in style.
OUT! Khan picks his fourth wicket. A good length delivery on off, Handscomb looks for a flick but misses it. The ball hit his pads and a good shout from the bowler. The umpire raises his finger.
A good delivery! Yorker length, Peter makes some room and just digs it out. Gets an inside edge onto the ground towards the fine leg region. Two run added.
A couple to end the penultimate over. On the pads, this is flicked through square leg for a brace. 12 runs but two wickets from the over.
Jason Behrendorff is the new man in.

OUT! As plumb as it gets! Junaid gets his second in the over. This is bowled on the stumps, Carey looks to whip it but misses. It hits him on the pads. An appeal follows and the umpire raises his finger. Carey reviews, a review more in desperation I feel. Time for the replays and they show no bat involved and three reds. Carey has to continue to walk back.
Review time! Carey has been given out LBW but he reviews. Looks out.
FIVE WIDES! Poor bowling! Errs in line. Down the leg side, Rizwan has no chance as it goes past his diving glove and to the fine leg fence.
A good yorker on middle, it is jammed out.

OUT! TIMBER! Big Show's show comes to an end! He tried to innovate on the last ball it came off, this time it does not. An ugly sight when it does not though. He goes for the scoop but misses. The ball shatters the off pole. End of an excellent innings by Maxwell, this can now make a difference of at least 8 to 10 runs to the final total.
FOUR! Innovative Maxwell. A low full toss on off, Maxwell reverse  scoops it past the short third man fielder for another boundary to his name.
A back of a length on leg, Handscomb pulls it to mid-wicket for a single.
Junaid Khan to bowl the 49th over.
On the stumps, this is chopped towards point for a run.
FOUR! Off the mark in style! Slightly short and outside off, Handscomb goes onto the back foot and cuts it through point. It races away to the fence. 300 up for Australia.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! You miss, I hit stuff by Khan. Bowls it full and on the stumps. Stoinis misses his heave and sees the leg stump behind get disturbed. Third for Khan and Stoinis once again fails to make an impact. This is a top over till now from UK.
A swing and a miss! Outside off, Stoinis looks to heave it across the line but misses.
Nicely bowled and well played! This is full and outside off. Maxwell opens the face of the bat and guides it through point for a single.
Stoinis does the right thing by guiding it down to third man and giving the strike over to Maxwell.
Usman Khan is back on.

SIX! Another Maxwell special. A short of a length delivery around middle, Maxwell makes some room and lifts it from his back foot above the long off fielder. Shan Masood present there was eyeing it but, no chance for him, it is way above his head. Such power and such strength from The Big Show!
A back of a length on off, Marcus punches it and changes strike.
Maxwell drives it to long off for a single.
FOUR! Innovation at its best from Maxwell. A short delivery on middle and leg, Maxwell plays a reverse shot between point and cover for a boundary.

Back of a length on middle and leg, Stoinis punches it straight to the bowler.
Back of a length on off, this is pushed through covers for a run.
A single to end as this is hit down to long on.
FOUR! 50 up for Maxwell and it comes up in real quick time. He has provided the much-needed impetus Australia needed. He gets there by pulling it over short fine leg for a boundary.
A yorker outside off, Maxwell looks to jam it out but gets it off the inner half back to the bowler.
FOUR! Short ball and it sits up to be hit! Maxwell goes back and pulls it over the mid-wicket fielder for a boundary.

OUT! Marsh departs. Third wicket down for Australia. What a catch by Abid Ali. A short delivery by Khan on off, Marsh looks for a pull and just gets the slice of the blade. The ball goes in the air towards the mid off region. Abid Ali there, dives to his left and takes an absolute blinder. The celebrations are cut short though as he seems to have injured himself. A good innings from Marsh comes to an end. Pakistan need to keep taking wickets if they are to stem the run flow.
Wide! Khan slides down the leg side.
A single to end! 12 from this one and 26 from the last two. Marsh eases this down to long on and gets to the other end.

We are all set to begin. The Pakistan team is out in the middle. They are followed by the Australian openers Aaron Finch and Usman Khawaja. The left-hander will be on strike and he will be facing Mohammad Abbas who has the first new ball in hand. Here we go...
TOSS - Pakistan won the toss and they elect bowl first.

Hello and welcome everyone to the final match of the series between Australia and Pakistan. Despite this being a dead rubber still there is a lot at stake here. Australia will look to whitewash the hosts. On the other hand, Pakistan would love to salvage some pride with a win here. This is the last ODI the two teams will be playing and both would love to head into the tournament with winning momentum. Stay tuned for the toss in a bit.
